Aberaman.road: narrow winding cul-de-sac, no centre line, open drives and small lawns, some shared block-paved drives
Aberaman.note: A 1990s cul-de-sac of red and orange brick detached executive houses with bay windows, small gables and integral garages on open-plan plots with a few hedges.

Albert Road.road: normal width, dashed centre line, some street trees in the pavement, on-street parking
Albert Road.note: Large red-brick Edwardian houses with bays and gables, a few with white rendered upper floors or mock-Tudor gables, and the odd white bungalow, behind hedges and low brick walls.

Ammanford.road: short estate cul-de-sac on a slope, no centre line, retaining walls and steps up to some houses
Ammanford.note: 1990s red-brick houses with small tiled porches and bay windows, some stepped up the slope above brick retaining walls; only two views so few houses seen.

Ashcroft Close.road: normal width cul-de-sac, no centre line, pavements, give-way line at the mouth
Ashcroft Close.note: A 1960s-70s close of brick detached houses with shallow front gables and dark tile-hung upper floors, behind low brick walls, hedges and fences.

Balliol Road.note: Large red-brick detached houses behind hedges and white picket fences, generous gardens and mature trees.

Blaenant.road: estate cul-de-sac on a slope, no centre line, shared parking areas, turning head
Blaenant.note: 1990s hillside estate: buff or red brick detached houses with cream rendered uppers, and a stepped terrace of three-storey townhouses with garages below and railinged steps up to the doors.

Blaenavon.road: narrow estate road, no centre line
Blaenavon.note: Modern red-brick detached houses with gables and garages; one usable view.

Blagrave Farm Lane.road: narrow lane, no centre line, rough edges, thick trees and hedges
Blagrave Farm Lane.note: A narrow, overgrown edge-of-town lane with only one house clearly seen, a white-rendered chalet house with a dark tile roof behind a timber fence; the rest is hedge and woodland.

Blagrave Lane.road: narrow rural lane, no centre line, no pavement, grass edges
Blagrave Lane.note: Rural lane of scattered detached houses and a white-rendered cottage behind fences, fields and trees; houses barely visible, one view blank.

Buxton Avenue.road: normal width, no centre line, cars parked on the street
Buxton Avenue.note: Edwardian to 1920s semis and detached houses with bay windows, red brick below and often white render or roughcast above, behind low brick walls and fences.

Carlton Road.road: normal width, no centre line, grass verges and open front lawns
Carlton Road.note: 1960s-70s estate houses with shallow gables facing the road, white render or orange brick below and dark tile-hung or boarded upper floors, on open-plan lawns.

Charlotte Close.road: short block-paved cul-de-sac, no centre line, turning area
Charlotte Close.note: Small 2000s close of large red-brick houses with cream rendered gables and stone-look window heads behind low brick walls with railings and hedges; an older white rendered mock-Tudor house stands at the entrance.

Chazey Road.road: normal width, no centre line, grass verges, far west end becomes an unmade hedged track (Blagrave Lane)
Chazey Road.note: Leafy road of mixed-age detached houses and bungalows, red brick or white/cream render, largely hidden behind tall hedges, brick walls and gates.

Church Road.road: wide main road, dashed centre line, pavements, chevron signs at the bend, flint retaining walls
Church Road.note: A busy main road with Victorian red-brick buildings under slate roofs, a 1960s brick flat block, and a black-and-white mock-Tudor house above flint walls and hedges.

Clifton Park Road.road: normal width, centre markings at junction, no-entry/one-way signs
Clifton Park Road.note: Mix of red-brick semi-bungalows behind fences and older large houses, one with mock-Tudor gables, in a leafy setting; one view failed.

Conisboro Avenue.road: normal width through road with dashed centre line, some on-street parking
Conisboro Avenue.note: A long mixed road: Edwardian red-brick houses with rendered upper floors at the south end, later detached infill and 1970s orange-brick houses further north, mostly behind tall hedges and brick walls.

Copperfields.road: narrow cul-de-sac with turning head, period-style lamp posts, no centre line
Copperfields.note: 1980s-90s close of large red-brick detached houses with bay windows and gabled fronts set on open lawns.

Crispin Close.road: normal width, no centre line, cul-de-sac, open grass frontages with a few large trees
Crispin Close.note: 1960s-70s close of plain detached red and brown brick houses with shallow brown roofs, some dark panels between windows, attached garages and open lawns.

Cwmcarn.road: normal width estate road, no centre line
Cwmcarn.note: 1990s red-brick detached houses, several with black-and-white mock-Tudor gables, block-paved drives and open lawns.

Darell Road.road: normal width, no centre line, big mature trees in front gardens, on-street parking
Darell Road.note: Large Edwardian red-brick houses with tall chimneys, bays and rendered gables, mostly screened by clipped hedges on low brick walls and big garden trees.

Dellwood Park.road: narrow winding private-feeling cul-de-sac, no centre line, grass edges and mature trees and shrubberies
Dellwood Park.note: A leafy modern cul-de-sac of large red-brick detached houses with rendered or mock-Tudor timbered gables and bay windows among mature trees.

Dovedale Close.road: narrow close with turning head and grassed areas
Dovedale Close.note: Red-brick low-rise flats set in communal lawns with trees, plus newer red-brick houses behind fences.

Fernbrook Road.road: normal width, no centre line, grass verges, a grass island with trees at the bend/junction
Fernbrook Road.note: Red-brick 1930s-50s semis with two-storey bay windows and hipped brown tiled roofs behind picket fences and hedges, with grass verges and big conifers; the east end is hidden by hedges.

Geoffreyson Road.road: normal width, no centre line, grass verges
Geoffreyson Road.note: Red-brick semis from the 1930s-50s, some with bay windows, brown and dark tiled roofs, fences and hedges in front and grass verges.

Glyncastle.road: short estate cul-de-sac, no centre line, grass verge and thick hedge/woodland on one side
Glyncastle.note: Late-1980s/90s detached houses in buff or red brick with red tile-hung gables, integral garages and open front lawns; one side of the road is just hedge and trees.

Grass Hill.road: narrow, steep, no centre line, heavily wooded with overhanging trees
Grass Hill.note: A steep, narrow, heavily wooded lane where only glimpses of red-brick and white-painted detached houses show through the trees and hedges.

Graveney Drive.road: narrow, no centre line, wooded with steep banks on one side
Graveney Drive.note: A wooded drive with a few 1960s red-brick detached houses on sloping front lawns, the rest hidden by trees and banks.

Gurney Close.road: normal width cul-de-sac, no centre line, turning circle at the end
Gurney Close.note: A cul-de-sac of 1960s red and orange brick bungalows and a few chalet bungalows with brown concrete tile roofs behind low brick walls.

Gurney Drive.road: normal width, no centre line, small turning head with a grassy corner
Gurney Drive.note: 1960s brick bungalows with brown concrete tile roofs, some with white weatherboard gables and attached garages, on open-plan drives and lawns.

Hafod.road: normal width estate road, no centre line
Hafod.note: Modern red-brick detached houses with gabled porches and garages on open lawns; only one view loaded.

Haldane Road.road: normal width, no centre line, grass corner verges, quiet junctions
Haldane Road.note: A road of postwar bungalows with low brown-tiled hipped roofs behind low brick walls, hedges and fences, with grassy corners at the junctions.

Harrogate Road.road: normal width, no centre line, parked cars on the north side; the south side is mostly back fences, garages and a stone church
Harrogate Road.note: Late-Victorian red-brick villas and semis with slate roofs, white bands or chequered brickwork and tall chimneys along the north side behind low brick walls and hedges; the south side is back-garden fences, garages and St Andrew's church.

Hewett Avenue.road: narrowish, no centre line, grass verges, very tall hedges along long stretches
Hewett Avenue.note: A quiet road mostly walled in by tall hedges, with postwar bungalows behind low brick walls and a few pale-brick 1960s semis on open lawns.

Hewett Close.road: narrow cul-de-sac, no centre line, open lawns to the kerb
Hewett Close.note: A small close of buff-brick 1970s chalet bungalows and houses with steep brown tile roofs on open-plan lawns.

Highmoor Road.road: normal width, dashed centre line, pavements both sides, no verges
Highmoor Road.note: Red-brick Edwardian houses and a red-brick church hall, with tall hedges, close-board fences and low brick walls along the pavement hiding much of the housing.

Hilltop Road.road: normal width, no centre line, grass verges, turning circle at the east end
Hilltop Road.note: Plain postwar red-brick semis with bay windows and brown tiled roofs behind low fences and verges, ending in a turning circle with a few later brick detached houses.

Hunters Chase.road: normal width estate spine road, no centre line, pavements; many houses side-on with brick walls, fences and hedges along the road
Hunters Chase.note: A modern estate spine road lined mostly by hedges, fences and garden walls, with red and orange brick 1990s detached houses glimpsed side-on.

Ilkley Road.road: normal width, no centre line, some parked vans, mature street trees
Ilkley Road.note: Mixed interwar detached houses, some white rendered with mock-Tudor gables, some red brick, plus bungalows, mostly behind hedges and close-board fences; few houses were clearly visible.

Kelmscott Close.road: short cul-de-sac, no centre line, grass verges, turning circle with a small green at the end
Kelmscott Close.note: Small close of 1950s-60s red-brick detached houses with white windows, one chalet with a dark tile-hung gable, behind hedges and low brick walls with grass verges and big trees.

Kelvedon Way.road: normal width, no centre line, some cars parked on the road
Kelvedon Way.note: Street of 1950s-60s red-brick bungalows with hipped brown tiled roofs, small front bays and side garages, behind low brick walls, some topped with pierced concrete blocks.

Kidmore Road.road: normal width, dashed centre line; south end has pavements and low brick walls, north end has grass verges and hedges
Kidmore Road.note: South end is big red-brick Victorian/Edwardian villas (some with black-and-white gables) behind low brick walls; further north it turns to interwar houses with white render over brick behind hedges and grass verges.

Knowle Close.road: narrow cul-de-sac, no centre line, double yellow lines at the mouth
Knowle Close.note: A quiet close of long low red-brick bungalows with brown tiled roofs, garages and open lawns, mature trees behind.

Little Woodcote Close.note: No Street View on the close itself: the views snapped to Upper Woodcote Road (A4074) and to Knowle Close, showing only hedges and one white rendered house at the corner.

Mapledene.road: narrow winding road, no centre line, grass verges and mature trees, gated drives
Mapledene.note: Large modern red-brick detached houses in Georgian style with brick piers, railings and gates on low walls, along a leafy winding road.

Matlock Road.road: normal width, no centre line, cars parked on street
Matlock Road.note: Interwar semis with red-brick ground floors and white rendered upper floors under dark tiled roofs, fronted by hedges, fences and paved drives.

Midsummer Meadow.note: 1990s red-brick detached houses with red-brown tile-hung upper gables on open corner lawns, woodland edge.

Morecambe Avenue.road: normal width, no centre line, grass verges with street trees
Morecambe Avenue.note: 1930s red-brick semis with two-storey bay windows under small tile-hung gables, behind low walls and hedges on a verge-lined street.

Morlais.road: normal width hillside estate road, give-way lines at junction, no centre line
Morlais.note: 1980s-90s estate of red-brick detached houses with white-painted gables and integral garages on open-plan lawns, plus a stepped row of townhouses up the slope.

Oakley Road.road: normal width, no centre line, cars parked on street
Oakley Road.note: Edwardian red-brick semis with dormers and tall chimneys mixed with later red-brick detached houses, behind low brick walls and hedges; only 3 of 6 views loaded.

Orwell Close.note: 1960s-70s red-brick detached houses with white boarded upper panels and front porches, open-plan sloping lawns.

Pinewood Drive.road: narrow lane-like road, no centre line, double yellow lines, tall conifers and hedges close to the kerb
Pinewood Drive.note: Narrow tree-lined drive; one modern orange-brick detached house with a bay window and an older red-brick house in the distance were all that showed past conifers and hedges.

Queensborough Drive.road: normal width cul-de-sac, no centre line, open-plan fronts with drives and attached flat-roofed garages
Queensborough Drive.note: 1960s-70s estate houses in red brick with white boarded or rendered upper floors, shallow roofs and attached garages on open-plan fronts.

Rhigos.road: estate cul-de-sac, no centre line, shared drives, turning head
Rhigos.note: 1990s detached red-brick houses with bay windows, small decorative timber trusses in the gables, attached garages and open front lawns.

Richmond Road.road: normal width, no centre line, grass verges
Richmond Road.note: A quiet road of individually built detached houses and a few bungalows, red brick or white render, mostly screened by tall hedges with grass verges.

Ridge Hall Close.road: normal width, no centre line, cul-de-sac, tall pines kept among open lawns
Ridge Hall Close.note: 1960s-70s close of detached brown and buff brick houses with shallow roofs, uppers hung with red-brown tiles or clad in white boards, flat-roofed garages and porches, and open-plan lawns and block-paved drives.

River Road.road: narrow unmade gravel lane, no centre line, no pavement
River Road.note: Big Victorian red-brick villa plus later detached houses and a chalet bungalow along a gravel lane; one view failed, imagery dated 2012.

Saint David's Close.road: normal width, centre line only at the junction, cul-de-sac with a garage court, fences along the entrance
Saint David's Close.note: 1960s-70s close of chalet-style semis and detached houses with steep brown tiled roofs sweeping down over the ground floor, brick below and white boarding above, with open front gardens.

Sandcroft Road.road: normal width, dashed centre line, grass verges
Sandcroft Road.note: 1960s-70s detached houses with dark tile-hung or boarded upper floors over brick, and white-rendered houses, behind short hedges.

Shepherds Lane.road: normal width, dashed centre line, grass verges between road and pavement on both sides
Shepherds Lane.note: A through lane with grass verges where mixed-age detached houses and chalet bungalows, some white rendered and some newer orange brick, sit well back behind tall hedges and fences.

Sheridan Avenue.road: normal width on a hill, no centre line, grass verges, cars parked on street
Sheridan Avenue.note: A 1950s hillside street of red-brick semis mixed with red-brick bungalows, brown tiled roofs, low brick front walls with hedges and grass verges.

Silverthorne Drive.road: normal width, no centre line, grass verges with small trees, cars parked on the road
Silverthorne Drive.note: 1960s estate of semis and detached houses with brick ground floors and white or cream boarded/rendered uppers, plus buff-brick chalet bungalows with big dormers at the west end; mostly open lawns with a few hedges.

St Peter's Avenue.road: normal width, no centre line seen, grass verges with big street trees; a long flint-and-brick wall at the south end
St Peter's Avenue.note: Leafy avenue of mixed-age detached houses and some bungalows, mostly hidden behind tall hedges, fences and mature trees.

St. Andrew's Road.road: normal width, no centre line, on-street parking
St. Andrew's Road.note: Mixed road: large Victorian red-brick detached house with slate roof and white gables beside 1930s semis with rendered upper floors and later red-brick houses, behind hedges and low walls.

Symeon Place.road: private-style estate road, no centre line, curving, parking bays and a brick garage block, communal lawns
Symeon Place.note: 2000s development of three-storey red-brick blocks of flats and townhouses with cream rendered ground floors and bays, balconies and hipped roofs, set in communal lawns with clipped hedges.

The Grange.road: curving estate cul-de-sac, no centre line, block-paved drives, grass verges
The Grange.note: 1990s executive estate of large detached red-brick houses with double garages, front gables that are tile-hung or pale rendered, brown tiled roofs and open lawns with shrubs.

The Mount.road: normal width, centre line at the junction end, on-street parking, mature trees
The Mount.note: Large Edwardian red-brick villas and semis with white-painted bay windows, gables, balconies and tall chimneys behind clipped hedges and low brick walls.

The Warren.road: narrow wooded lane, no centre line, no pavements, partly unmade
The Warren.note: A narrow leafy lane where large detached houses are almost entirely hidden behind tall hedges, brick walls, fences and mature trees; wall and roof proportions are guesses from glimpses.

Tredegar Road.road: normal width hillside road, dashed centre line, double yellow lines at the junction, long stretches with woodland, railings or open land instead of houses
Tredegar Road.note: A hillside road with long green gaps of trees and scrub, and a stepped row of white-rendered and brick houses with orange roofs at the southern end.

Treforgan.road: estate road, no centre line, houses on one side and a wooded hedge bank with grass verge on the other
Treforgan.note: 1990s detached red-brick houses with front gables, bay windows and integral garages on open plots; the other side of the road is a thick hedge bank; only two views.

Tyler Close.road: narrow close, no centre line, grass verge
Tyler Close.note: 1960s-70s close with buff-brick garages and screen-block walls; houses mostly hidden.

Tylorstown.road: narrow cul-de-sac, no centre line, open front lawns, hedges along the entrance
Tylorstown.note: A 1990s cul-de-sac of red-brick detached houses with dormers and gabled porches on open lawns, screened from the road by hedges.

Tymawr.road: estate road, no centre line, block-paved sections and parking court, wooded bank behind
Tymawr.note: 1990s estate of buff-brick detached houses with bay windows, some dark tile-hung gables and attached garages, plus a red-brick terrace; open drives and tiny front gardens.

Uplands Road.road: normal width, no centre line, parked cars and vans, long runs of close-board side/back fences
Uplands Road.note: Mostly side and back garden fences on the stretches seen, with red-brick interwar semis and detached houses under hipped tiled roofs, a red-roofed chalet bungalow and a white rendered house.

Upper Warren Avenue.road: normal width, centre line only near the east end, wooded avenue with large mature trees and rough verges
Upper Warren Avenue.note: Wooded avenue of large detached houses and bungalows on big plots, almost entirely hidden by hedges, gates and mature trees; a red-tiled bungalow, a cream rendered house and a new orange-brick house were glimpsed.

Upper Woodcote Road.road: A-road, wide, centre line, hatched centre markings, wide grass verges both sides, big trees
Upper Woodcote Road.note: Wide main road with grass verges; detached houses and chalets of mixed age (red brick with white rendered or dark-timbered gables, cream render with red tile roofs, a few interwar semis) set back behind tall hedges and low brick walls.

Westdene Crescent.road: narrow crescent with a central grass island, no centre line
Westdene Crescent.note: Red-brick bungalows and chalet bungalows with steep brown tiled roofs and dormers, low brick walls, around a grassed island.

Wincroft Road.road: normal width, dashed centre line near junction, wide grass verges
Wincroft Road.note: Bungalows and modest detached houses glimpsed behind tall fences and hedges, red brick with brown tiled roofs, with wide grass verges.

Winterberry Way.road: normal estate road, no centre line, gentle curves, side closes off it
Winterberry Way.note: Late-1980s/90s estate of detached buff and red brick houses with front gables, some red tile-hung or dark-boarded uppers, garages and a few bungalows, on open fronts with shrubs and hedges.

Woburn Close.road: narrow cul-de-sac with turning head, no centre line, cars on street
Woburn Close.note: 1960s-70s close of orange/buff-brick terraces and link-detached houses, some with tile-hung or boarded upper panels, open frontages and trees at the end.

Woodcote Road.road: A-road, normal to wide, centre line, hatched/turning markings at junctions, narrow grass verges with black-and-white bollards
Woodcote Road.note: Main road of Edwardian and interwar red-brick houses with bay windows and some black-and-white gables, behind tall hedges and close-board fences, plus a modern orange-brick block and the odd bungalow.

Woodcote Way.road: normal width, no centre line, grass verges between kerb and pavement
Woodcote Way.note: Plain red-brick bay-windowed semis from the 1930s-50s with hipped brown tiled roofs, behind low brick walls, hedges and fences with grass verges.

Woodford Close.road: normal width cul-de-sac, no centre line, open-plan front lawns running to the kerb
Woodford Close.note: A 1960s-70s close of buff and orange brick detached houses with white panels around the windows and shallow roofs on open-plan lawns.

Wrenfield Drive.road: normal width hillside road, no centre line, grass verge, houses raised above the road with sloping drives
Wrenfield Drive.note: Postwar red-brick semis with hipped roofs stepping up a hillside above the road, with a long fenced verge with young trees on the other side.

Wychcotes.road: narrow cul-de-sac, no centre line, grass banks and very large cedars/pines
Wychcotes.note: Small 1960s close of brown-brick detached houses and bungalows with low brown roofs among big cedars, hedges and grass banks; little was visible in the two views.
